assignment_source: SHA-256 of each replicate's responses.md, sorted; deterministic and not selected by the rater or by anyone who has seen a score
byte_identical_note: Replicates with the same response digest are reported, not refused. Phase 1 found the standing runtime reproducing every generation when request history was held fixed, so identical replicates are a state this measurement must be able to report. Ties break by run id so the labelling stays deterministic.
do_not_open: Open only after the aggregated blind scores are committed. Git history is the audit trail.
